# Kate Solmara

> Kate Solmara (pronounced soul-MAR-uh) is an Arizona-based independent singer-songwriter making warm, emotionally honest indie folk-pop. Her debut single "Ease" was released July 24, 2026.

## Music
- "Ease" (2026), indie folk-pop. Written by Katie Kness and Adam Lamb, produced by Adam Lamb, guitar by Dylan Elliott. Published by Kate Solmara (ASCAP). ISRC QT6EA2644595, UPC 882518335764. Clean. Running time 3:41. Key of A, 166 BPM (4/4). 24-bit / 44.1 kHz WAV.
- Mood: warm, sunlit, golden-hour, uplifting, soaring, emotionally generous. Opens intimate, then builds into layered harmonies and a soaring release.
- Scene fit: character introductions, everyday-routine montages, the turn toward letting go, the moment someone finally exhales.
- Press: "Damn, Kate. It soars." (BOPS); "A breathtaking folk-pop debut with the soaring polish of an established superstar." (It's All Indie); "Warm, understated and emotionally generous." (No Transmission); "The song version of a 'digital detox.'" (Lost in the Manor); "A light that explodes in your chest." (The Other Side Reviews) Themes: letting go, rest, carrying too much, choosing ease over striving.
- Listen: [Spotify](https://open.spotify.com/track/4dL2Sv9Ds2yweuXFF7PB9Z), [Apple Music](https://music.apple.com/us/song/ease/6783796053), [Bandcamp](https://katesolmara.bandcamp.com/track/ease)

## For press and radio
- Request the press kit through the contact form at https://katesolmara.com/#contact

## Sync and licensing
- "Ease" is one-stop: Kate Solmara controls 100% of the master and the publishing, so one approval clears both sides.
- Clean version, instrumental, full backing track and stems are ready to send; 15/30/60 second cutdowns on request.
- Licensing inquiries: info@katesolmara.com
